summary: All nine assertions are justified by the supplied accepted facts and the candidate's arguments. The retained-area envelope bound covers empty retained sets, zero-area sections, and endpoint anchors. The active-halfspace proof establishes one maximizing point satisfying the required bound for every containing closed ambient halfspace, including horizontal boundaries. The sector estimates, four-entry scalar alternative, fixed-length and variable-length tail comparisons, simultaneous two-anchor domination, parameter domains, sharp continuous inequality, and exact five-entry obstruction check out, including their stated equality and zero-tail cases. The universal scalar alternative in assertion (7) is correctly left as a conditional antecedent rather than asserted as proved. No mathematical error or proof gap was found.
